subject: This Week at Lincoln Elementary
body: Reminders for this week: Science Fair projects are due next Thursday at 9:00am in the gym. Math homework packet is due Monday. Friday is Spirit Day - wear school colors. The PTA meeting is Tuesday at 6:00pm in the library.
why: Baseline multi-item classification/extraction test — no correction or negotiation expected.

subject: Attendance: Doctor's note required
body: Your child has been marked absent for 3 consecutive days. Per school policy, a doctor's note is required to excuse these absences. Please schedule a pediatric visit and submit documentation within 5 school days.
why: Exercises needs_calendar=true with real urgency; good candidate to see negotiation fire if your calendar has anything booked in the next 5 days at the proposed time.

subject: Quick question about the field trip form
body: Hi! I noticed the permission slip for next month's field trip hasn't come back yet. Could you let me know if you're able to sign and return it by Friday? Thanks!
why: Exercises needs_email=true — should end up queued in the approval loop, never auto-sent. Good test that the red-alert gate actually holds.

subject: Important update
body: Please note the change for this Thursday. Details are in the portal. Let the office know if you have questions.
why: Deliberately vague — no explicit category, date, or action. Good test of whether School Agent under-commits (low confidence) rather than guessing, and whether Control Tower's classification QC flags it.

subject: PTA Meeting - Time Change
body: Note: this month's PTA meeting has moved to tomorrow at 9:00am in the library due to a scheduling conflict on our end.
why: Short-notice, specific next-day time — a good candidate for a real conflict with your actual calendar, to see the Calendar Agent negotiate or Control Tower break a deadlock.
